recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the active diff generator regresses and stops linking added resource/type rows, or if a separate archival-publication process is created for editing frozen 2016sep pages.
issue_request: FHIR-11219 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request raised against the 2016 September core diff page asking for links from the list of changed resources/pages, especially added values, to make navigation easier.
initial_application: Jira records an SVN revision note, but the visible link-specific implementation trail is git-svn d5e285ea9061 (@11426), which attempted to pass a type/resource link provider into the diff renderer, followed by immediate revert 00133155b7ae because the interface was missing, and then e3e58fc30dc7 (@11430), which added TypeLinkProvider to SpecDifferenceEvaluator and PageProcessor so diff rows for known types/resources can render anchors. The current source no longer carries this old Java tooling, but the current built diff pages still use the diff-analysis macros that feed the active difference-analysis output.
additional_context: The active source pages source/diff.html, source/diff-r4.html, source/diff-r4b.html, and source/diff-r5.html are included in the page hierarchy and publish manifest. The current rendered build shows added resource/type rows such as DeviceAlert, InsuranceProduct, Availability, and BackboneType as anchors. The original 2016sep URL remains a frozen historical publication and is not a current-build source target.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build already provides links for the added resource/type entries that were the meaningful target of the issue, and changing static narrative would not affect the generated diff rows.
